## What does Dreamup do?

DreamUp is an AI image generator that creates artwork from text prompts. Describe what you want—such as the subject, style, colors, and background—and generate results in a range of visual directions like anime, 3D, cinematic, and more.

Refine your outputs by adjusting prompt strength and the aspect ratio before finalizing. This makes it easier to steer the look and framing of your image rather than relying on a single default generation.

DreamUp also includes options aimed at fair use and creator protections, including an ability for artists to opt out of AI-generated images being created in their style. It can also credit artists appropriately when their style inspires a DreamUp-generated image, and it supports settings related to whether external AI models and platforms can use art for training.

### What can I create with DreamUp?

You can generate AI images by entering detailed text prompts that specify your desired subject, style, colors, and background.

### Which styles are available in DreamUp?

DreamUp offers multiple visual styles, including anime, 3D, cinematic, and more.

### Can I control how the final image looks?

Yes—use prompt strength and aspect ratio adjustments to fine-tune results before finalizing.

### Is there a way to protect an artist’s style from being used?

Artists can opt out of AI-generated images being created in their style. If a DreamUp image is inspired by an artist’s style, proper credit is provided under DeviantArt’s policies.

### Do DreamUp prompts roll over to the next month?

No. Prompts don’t roll over and expire at the end of the calendar month.

### What are the basic usage limits for DreamUp?

The free tier allows up to 30 images per week using 10 prompts. Core Members can generate up to 500 prompts per month depending on their Core plan, with additional prompts available via DeviantArt Points after free prompts are used.
